module.name: tooltip
module.title: Tooltip
module.description: The Tooltip renderer and its options.

ui.name: tooltip
ui.summary: Renders an inline tooltip on hover/focus.
ui.guidance: The trigger is the caller's own element (children), so this renderer cannot put aria-describedby on it; the text is exposed with role="tooltip" and the association belongs to the trigger-owning API in the component catalog.
